messages:
Mina: quick share — Taco the parrot just learned to mimic my standup 'blocking on infra' line and now won't stop. uploaded: taco_standup.mp4
Jorge: no way that's not the future of sprint demos :joy: can we get a demo on loop during All Hands?
Ava: omg imagine Taco doing engineering onboarding. 'first rule: don't push to main before lunch' :parrot: :rofl:
Mina: he also steals Post-its. watched him take one and fly off like a tiny project manager.
Theo: video was chef's kiss. audio had perfect timing, 0ms latency. low jitter too.
Rina: clip request: please post a gif. also curious if he knows any swear words yet or just corporate jargon :eyes:
Mina: no bad words. only picks up things we say on calls 3: 'deploy at 3' and 'blocker' are his faves.
Jorge: petition to add Taco to the company org chart under "morale" :raised_hands:
Ava: ops-bot, are pets allowed in the office for a quick morale drop-in? (Taco is small, in a carrier)
ops-bot: Reminder: Office pet visits require People Ops pre-approval. Birds should be transported in secure carriers; no free-flight policy indoors. Please file a Pet Visit request form with People Ops at least 72 hours prior.
Mina: will do. low-key thought: virtual cameo during next retro? put him on the mic to say 'LGTM' at the end of PR reviews.
Theo: caption contest: "When your CI passes and the parrot insists on doing the release notes" :memo: :tada:
Rina: caption: "Taco: automating morale since yesterday" :sparkles:
Mina: ok tiny poll — virtual cameo only / quick lobby hello / brief desk cameo (react with 1/2/3). also open to name suggestions for his GitHub handle :)
